intelligence.essence: The second Inspector sweep refines the same law at finer grain: the eye's 'i' must read in black on pearl, the day view is prime real estate, the Factory formats everything itself, one bar and one mail serve the whole world — alive like a high-tech computer, and scored without excitement.
intelligence.human_view: The refinements land where your fingers and eyes actually go: the little information eye becomes readable at a glance, opening a day feels like stepping into a cockpit full of your day, the bottom bar is the same five doors everywhere, and there's one Smart Mail — the best of both versions — instead of two half-right ones.
intelligence.child_view: A button nobody can read is just a shiny pebble. We put the black letter back in the middle of the pearl so you can actually read it. And when there are two of something — two mailboxes, two bars — we keep the best parts of each and make one good one.
intelligence.grandma_view: This is the second pass over the same ground, and that's the point: the first sweep sets the rules, the second checks them at reading distance. Is the letter in the eye readable? Does the day page feel like a cockpit or a cupboard? Excitement about an idea, he reminded us, is not a verdict on the thing built.
intelligence.ai_view: Operating rules distilled from SN-3255..SN-3264: (1) The eye, black in the middle: the pearl disc is a real object off the page, but the 'i' must READ — a real object nobody can read is a decoration, not a control. (2) The day view is a dashboard: prime real estate — appointments as tiles, timeline, notes, the day's report, Intel, news, weather — a cockpit, not a menu of buttons. (3) The Inspector, full sweep: the standing seat sweeps the whole surface, not a sample. (4) The Factory is the formatter: Epic formatting built as its own app is a second factory — one system, not another; nobody comes to a separate app for one piece of formatting. (5) One bottom bar: the five, everywhere — when he asked which ones, the answer was decided on the spot: the Personal five. (6) Best of both — one Smart Mail: two presentations of the same app is the mess; merge elegance from one and icons from the other, neither thrown away whole. (7) Alive like a high-tech computer, not a video game: the orbs stay; the flavour of motion is the law — more alive is better when it feels like a machine, not a game. (8) The calendar scorecard: excitement is not a verdict — 'super excited until we created it'; low-end cheap, elementary tech, with three named corrections. (9) The best buttons in the system are a pointable standard: three live buttons on the Dashboard. (10) No huge today: today does not light up over itself — his 03:54 correction overrules his 03:47 ask; glow over the day is the defect the whole glow law names.
intelligence.what_it_means: Refinement is not new law but the same law at finer grain — readability over beauty, one over two, the later correction over the earlier ask — and the discipline of scoring the built thing cold, however exciting the idea was.

page.machine: 1) Controls: readability gates decoration — the glyph must read. 2) Day view: dashboard composition, never a button menu. 3) Formatting lives in the Factory; no parallel formatter apps. 4) Duplicates: merge best-of-both into one; never maintain two. 5) Motion flavour: high-tech computer. 6) Verdicts: score the built thing; excitement scores zero; later correction overrules earlier ask.
page.why_it_matters: Second sweeps are where quality actually compounds: the first pass sets direction, the second catches what only shows at reading distance. This group is the team's own batch discipline — prove, then re-prove finer — written as design law.
page.how_it_connects: Ninth movement of batch 14, the second Inspector sweep answering SN-4744's first. Its one-mail and one-bar rulings feed the Smart Bar and Smart Mail packets already in Nitro's hands; its correction-overrules rule is exercised in SN-4746's closing doctrine.
page.what_is_in_it_for_you: You get one of everything that matters — one mail, one bar, one formatter — each the best merged version, and controls you can actually read at a glance.
page.the_learning: From now on, when two versions exist we merge their best into one instead of maintaining both — and we score the built thing cold, because excitement about the idea is not evidence about the artifact.
